pages.text: Some creatures live in nests made from dirt and bones around the world. The nest will host more and more monsters until it's destroyed.$(br2)A monster nest is very hard to break, and while it's well-known that a nest can be destroyed with an explosion, some rumours say that it can also be destroyed with an efficiency enchantment strong enough.
But breaking one has a reward, as monsters usually hide magic goods inside them.
